releases.body:
## Summary

**Migrated from flat `commands/` to OpenCode's `skills/` directory convention.** Each skill is now a subdirectory containing `SKILL.md` (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`), installed recursively into `<project>/.opencode/skills/`. The installer was rewritten as a depth-first `copyDir` and remains idempotent (never overwrites user-customised files).

## Breaking / Migration

- **Source layout:** `commands/*.md` → `skills/*/SKILL.md` (5 skills: `wiki-agents-file`, `wiki-archive`, `wiki-consistency`, `wiki-dedup`, `wiki-sync`).
- **Rename:** `wiki-update` → `wiki-sync` (`commands/wiki-update.md` → `skills/wiki-sync/SKILL.md`). Backward-compat shims kept in `opencode.json` so `/wiki-update` still resolves to `/skill:wiki-sync` (same for the other four `wiki-*` commands).
- **Install target:** `.opencode/commands/` → `.opencode/skills/` (`src/index.ts:8`, `src/index.ts:27`).
- **Removed:** `openwiki.json` (contained only `model: opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`) — model selection now left to the host.

## Changes

- **`src/index.ts:34`** — `COMMANDS_DIR` → `SKILLS_DIR`; flat `readdir` + `readFile`/`writeFile` loop replaced with recursive `copyDir(src, dest)` using `readdir({ withFileTypes: true })` + `fs.copyFile`; preserves `installed`/`skipped` counts.
- **`opencode.json:3`** — added `command` map with 5 entries (`wiki-agents-file`, `wiki-archive`, `wiki-consistency`, `wiki-dedup`, `wiki-update`→`wiki-sync`) each as `{ template: "/skill:...", description, agent: "build" }` for compat.
- **`AGENTS.md:11`** — docs updated to `skill/*` → `.opencode/skills/`.
- **`skills/*/SKILL.md`** — all five skills moved to subdirectory layout; frontmatter refreshed (`name`/`description`/`agent: build`); body edits are formatting/line-wrap only, no behaviour change beyond the `wiki-sync` rename.
- **`wiki/INDEX.md:10`** — added [Skills Directory Migration](wiki/pages/2026-09-17-skills-directory-migration.md) entry; escaped `*` in older entry; added topic clusters.
- **Tests:** `test/commands.test.ts` now asserts exact subdirectory list + `SKILL.md` presence; `test/index.test.ts` renamed helper to `listInstalledSkills` and checks `.opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` paths (9 tests pass).
- **`wiki/pages/2026-09-17-skills-directory-migration.md`** — new implementation page documenting the migration (before/after code, test results).

## Housekeeping

- `package.json:3` — version `0.4.1-a` → `0.5.0-a`; description em-dash normalised.
- ⚠️ **Known issue in this tag:** `package.json:8` `files` still lists `"commands"` instead of `"skills"` — published tarball will omit the `skills/` directory. Fix to `"skills"` before `npm publish`.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/manti-by/openwiki/compare/v0.4.1-a...v0.5.0-a

## Summary

**OpenWiki is now a pure install-only plugin.** The background Wiki Agent, the `session.idle` event hook, the `openwiki_init`/`openwiki_write` tools, and all host-coupled code (`@opencode-ai/plugin` imports, `src/lib/summarize.ts`, `src/lib/wiki.ts`) are gone. On load the plugin now only does two idempotent things:

- Copies every `commands/*.md` into `<project>/.opencode/commands/` (never overwriting user-customised files).
- Writes the `wiki/` scaffold (`README.md`, `TEMPLATE.md`, `INDEX.md`, `QUESTIONS.md`) with `<PROJECT_NAME>` substituted, skipping existing files.

## Commands

- **Removed:** `/wiki-init` and `/wiki-write` - the scaffold now installs automatically on plugin load, and wiki writing is driven by `/wiki-update`.
- **New: `/wiki-update`** - one page per session under `wiki/pages/`, keyed by   `session_id` in frontmatter with a `wiki/.openwiki-sessions.json` mapping fallback; every invocation updates the same file, preserving frontmatter and appending dated `## Update - YYYY-MM-DD` sections. 
- **New: `/wiki-archive`** - archives pages older than 3 months (or an explicit age like `/wiki-archive 6mo`), distilling durable content into current pages before retiring originals to `wiki/archive/`; skips `open`/`in-progress` pages and those with open follow-ups.
- **New: `/wiki-agents-file`** - revalidates `AGENTS.md` against the codebase, wiki, and git log, auto-applying fixes and printing a diff summary.
- **Updated:** `/wiki-consistency` and `/wiki-dedup` rewritten for the new install-only model.

## Housekeeping

- **Zero runtime dependencies** - no `@opencode-ai/plugin` devDependency either; build no longer externalises it.
- Migrated docs to a no-markdown-tables convention (flat bullet lists / card sections) across `AGENTS.md`, templates, and wiki pages.
- New wiki audit pages and tests for the install/command-copy behaviour.
- Default model updated in `openwiki.json` (`opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/manti-by/openwiki/compare/v0.3.0-rc4...v0.4.1-a

## Fixes

- **`OpenWiki` is now also the module's default export.** rc4 added the self-bootstrap on plugin load but only as a *named* export. OpenCode's plugin loader reads `mod.default` (`packages/opencode/src/plugin/shared.ts:readV1Plugin`) and calls `applyPlugin` in `detect` mode, which silently returns when the default export is missing. Result: the rc4 factory — and therefore `installCommandsIfMissing` — was never invoked, the four `/wiki-*` slash commands were never copied into `.opencode/commands/`, and the rc4 release notes described a fix that did not actually take effect in production. This release adds `export default OpenWiki` so the host's dynamic-import path finds the factory.

## Tests

- New regression test pins the default export to the named `OpenWiki` function. Without it, the host's `import()` boundary was never exercised in CI.
- 29 pass / 0 fail (`bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test`).

## Upgrade

- Bump `@manti-by/openwiki` to `0.3.0-rc5` and re-install. The bootstrap is idempotent — projects that already have the four commands are no-ops.
- No code changes required on the consumer side. `opencode.json` plugin entry is unchanged.

## Zero-config install

The plugin now self-installs its slash commands. Adding the plugin
to `opencode.json` and restarting OpenCode is enough — the four
`/wiki-*` commands are copied into `<project>/.opencode/commands/`
on the plugin's first load (skipping any you've already customised),
and `/wiki-init` is available immediately.

Why the previous release wasn't enough: OpenCode plugins cannot
register slash commands through the SDK. The API exposes `tool`,
`event`, and various hooks, but no command registration, and
commands are discovered from disk before plugins finish loading.
So the file has to be on disk before OpenCode scans it — the only
way to make that automatic is for the plugin to write the file
itself during `OpenWiki()`.

The `wiki/` scaffold is still gated behind an explicit `/wiki-init`
(or a call to the `openwiki_init` tool) so nothing else gets
written without the user asking.

## Changes

- `OpenWiki` factory runs `installCommandsIfMissing` before
  returning — copies `commands/*.md` into `<project>/.opencode/commands/`,
  skips existing files.
- `initWiki` delegates to the same helper; the `openwiki_init` tool
  description is updated to reflect that commands now install
  automatically.
- README install flow updated: add plugin → restart → `/wiki-init`
  is the entire setup.
- Tests cover fresh install, no-overwrite of a customised command,
  and the no-op re-load case.

## Fixes

- **`openwiki_init` now actually installs the slash commands.** The tool description
  and README both promised that running it would scaffold `wiki/` **and** install
  `/wiki-init`, `/wiki-write`, `/wiki-consistency`, and `/wiki-dedup` into
  `.opencode/commands/`, but only the wiki/ scaffolding happened — the commands
  were silently dropped. `initWiki` now copies every `commands/*.md` into
  `<project>/.opencode/commands/`, skipping files that already exist so
  user-customised commands survive a re-run.

## Internal

- Tests cover both the fresh-install and the idempotent re-run paths.
- `make check` and `npm publish --dry-run` are clean.
